candidates.summary: Entry of calculate_screen_addresses_for_movers_on_edge: test &CF first and branch back to a JMP edge_right placed (with edge_leave_a1's RTS) just before the entry label; LDY #&00 only on the left-edge path, since edge_right writes Y (LDY #n / LDY #&21) before ever reading it. Same 10 bytes, 1 cycle less on each path.
candidates.equivalence: Old: LDY#0(2) LDX&CF(3) BEQ(2/3) JMP(3) = right 10, left 8. New: LDX&CF(3) BNE(3 taken, same page)/(2) then JMP(3) = right 9; left LDX(3) BNE(2) LDY#0(2) = 7, falling straight into edge_left_loop as before. Left path enters edge_left_loop with Y=0, X=&CF=0, C unchanged (neither LDX, BNE nor LDY touches C, so ground_square's CLC still holds), Z/N from LDY#0 (Z=1,N=0) where old had them from LDX &CF (Z=1,N=0) - same. Right path enters edge_right with X=&CF, flags N/Z from LDX (old: same, LDX was the last flag-setter), C/V unchanged; Y differs (old 0, new whatever the caller left) but edge_right (scroll_hazel.6502) begins LDA edge_x_low, then only CMP/BNE/LDY #n/JSR hit per mover and LDY #&21 before the tail JMP: Y is written before any read on every path. Callers (game.6502 1109, 1407) only JSR the label; grep finds no 'calculate_screen_addresses_for_movers_on_edge +' entry and no other reference; edge_leave_a1's two BNE users (BNE at &19BE, &19CB) still reach it (it moves 3 bytes, from &1990 to &198A, still in page &19). Total size of the block unchanged (3+1+2+2+2 = 10 = 2+2+2+3+1), so nothing after it moves.
candidates.relies_on: edge_right never reads Y before writing it; the block's size is unchanged so no later code or table moves; in the shipping listing the entry moves &1987->&198B, the JMP sits at &1987, the BNE at &198D branches back to &1987 in the same page (no +1); edge_leave_a1 moves &1990->&198A, still page &19 for the BNEs at &19BE/&19CB (in -Shift builds all these addresses shift together by the same page multiple, so the page relations hold). Executions: LDY #&00 measured 0.8 cycles a pass at 2 cycles = 0.4 calls a pass.
